title: Can hot air from nitriding-furnace cooling be used to dry parts?
summary: Retort cooling and drying after washing can share a hot-air connection. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s nitriding package proposal for riveted/welded special electrical-switch parts, dated 12 September 2018, directs hot air from cooling vessels through ducting to a drying vessel for washed parts. Suitability depends on when heat is available, drying loads and a clear boundary from the retort's internal process atmosphere.
